declared: 2026-11-07, before the frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle of these exact bytes. The drafts' lang-item and feature prerequisites were settled against rustc 1.98.0 in obj/parallel/census-batch6/repro first; each outcome follows the stated rule, not that exploration

option-copy-wait.rs.reason: a declaration-phase array length runs a const fn that copies Choice<u32>; the generic `impl<T: Copy> Copy for Choice<T>` and its const Clone are validated on demand, so the copy waits instead of failing

root-copy-wait.rs.reason: the same copy of Choice<u32> in the anonymous length block itself, so the waiting body is the constant's root

nonzero-copy-wait.rs.reason: core NonZero shape: Wide<T: Zeroable>(T::Inner) with `impl<T> Copy for Wide<T> where T: Zeroable`, copied inside Choice<Wide<u32>>; the projected field's lifetime contract is demanded early

copy-length-mismatch.rs.reason: opponent: the waiting copy returns 3, so a [u8; 3] is not [u8; 4] (E0308)

not-copy-move.rs.reason: opponent: Choice<Plain> has no Copy impl for Plain, so the second use reads a moved value (E0382)

field-not-copy.rs.reason: opponent: `impl<T: Copy> Copy for Holder<T>` with a non-Copy Plain field cannot be implemented (E0204), so the waiting constant cannot use it

validation-cycle.rs.reason: opponent: the Copy impl's where-clause names an array whose length is the waiting constant itself, a cycle (E0391)

later-projected-copy-wait.rs.reason: the NonZero shape with the trait, its scalar impl and the wrapper declared after the waiting const fn, which destructures the projected field
